title: Hay Festival Segovia
venue: IE University, Teatro Juan Bravo and city venues
description: Conversations with international writers and thinkers connect literature, philosophy, architecture and visual art in Segovia's historic centre. The final weekend remains on 12–13 September.
accessNote: Book individual events; check each session's language, venue and remaining availability.
notes: Already underway; 12–13 September remain inside the tracker window. Main festival dates are 10–13 September 2026.

title: Gothenburg Book Fair
venue: Swedish Exhibition & Congress Centre, Mässans gata 10
description: A major Nordic gathering for books and ideas, with 2026 themes spanning popular adult education and games. Author encounters range from crime fiction to fantasy and international literature.
accessNote: Admission tickets cover the exhibition. Seminar passes and special-event tickets are sold separately; choose the ticket for the sessions you want.

title: Wigtown Book Festival
venue: Festival Marquee, County Buildings and town venues
description: Scotland's National Book Town hosts ten days of readings and conversations, with separate programmes for children and young adults alongside its independent bookshops.
accessNote: Book individual events through the festival box office; check venue addresses for sessions outside the town centre.

title: Frankfurt Book Fair · Public days
description: The public days of the international publishing fair bring author talks, readings, signings and book discoveries. Czechia is the 2026 Guest of Honour.
accessNote: Public admission starts Friday 9 October at 11:00; Saturday opens at 09:00 and Sunday at 09:00. Industry-only rights centres require the appropriate credentials and appointments.
scheduleNote: Calendar shows the public visitor dates. The full trade fair runs 7–11 October; 7–8 October are for trade visitors.

title: FÓLIO · Óbidos Literary Festival
venue: Venues across the village of Óbidos
description: The walled Portuguese town becomes a meeting place for authors, readers and artists, with literary conversations, readings, exhibitions and book launches.
accessNote: Festival dates are confirmed by the municipality. Check the 2026 programme for individual venues, session charges and reservations when published.

title: Cheltenham Literature Festival
venue: Town Hall, Garden Theatre and venues across Cheltenham
description: A long-running literary festival with fiction, poetry, public conversations and debates, plus a free storytelling programme around town.
accessNote: Book individual author events; the festival also offers free activities. Check the programme for session venues and ticket availability.

title: FILIT · Iași Literature & Translation Festival
venue: Festival venues across Iași; session venues to be announced
description: Romania's international literature and translation festival brings together writers, translators and readers for literary encounters, poetry, readings and professional discussions.
accessNote: The festival has confirmed 21–25 October. Check the 2026 programme for public-session reservations and any restricted professional workshops; detailed access is still to be announced.

title: Helsinki Book Fair
venue: Messukeskus · Helsinki Expo and Convention Centre
description: Finland's large autumn book fair gathers authors, readers and booksellers for conversations and new releases. The 2026 theme explores language and its possibilities in literature.
accessNote: Tickets are available through the official fair site. Check session languages and the programme, due to be published on 22 September.

title: International Book Fair in Kraków
description: A major Polish book fair for readers and publishing professionals, with author meetings and literary discussion in a UNESCO City of Literature.
accessNote: The fair is open to the general public. Public ticket sales are listed as coming soon; trade-visitor registration is a separate route.

title: Belgrade International Book Fair
description: A major regional meeting of publishers, writers and readers, with book presentations, panels and cultural exchange. Tunisia is the 2026 Guest of Honour.
accessNote: Open daily 10:00–20:00. Public admission and online tickets are listed on the organiser's calendar page; confirm current programme and ticket terms before visiting.

title: Bogforum · Copenhagen Book Festival
description: Denmark's large literary festival combines author conversations, interviews, book signings and a children's book festival. A new climate stage explores nature and the green transition.
accessNote: Public ticket sales are open through the organiser. Check programme times and languages; the children's festival has its own opening hours.

title: Dublin Book Festival · 20th Anniversary
description: Celebrating twenty years, Dublin's festival showcases Irish writing and publishing through author conversations, poetry, walking tours, workshops and family events.
accessNote: Choose individual events in the official programme; the festival includes a weekend of free family activities alongside bookable sessions.

title: Poetry in Aldeburgh · Infinite Worlds
venue: Jubilee Hall and four other Aldeburgh venues
description: A coastal poetry festival of readings, workshops and performances. The Infinite Worlds programme includes poetry in translation and headline poets Malika Booker, Joelle Taylor and Yomi Sode.
accessNote: Book individual readings and workshops through the official ticket link. Check each session's venue and access information.

title: Interliber · Zagreb Book Fair
description: Croatia's major book gathering brings publishers, readers and writers together for new releases, author signings and discussions, with storytelling activities for younger readers.
accessNote: The organiser confirms free admission for all visitors; check the programme for individual author sessions and workshops.

title: Slovenian Book Fair
description: Slovenia's annual gathering of publishers, booksellers and readers returns for seven days. Germany is the country in focus, with Sežana featured as the guest town.
accessNote: Admission to the fair is free. Consult the programme for individual stages and sessions, and the visitor page for transport offers.

title: Buch Wien · Book Fair & Festival
venue: Messe Wien, Halls C and D, plus city venues
description: Vienna's book fair and literary festival combines literature, nonfiction, live podcasts and programmes for children and young adults, with evening events across the city.
accessNote: Ticket sales begin 15 September. Wednesday opens at 16:30; day tickets and festival passes are offered. Check evening events for venue and entry details.

title: Montreuil Children's Book & Press Fair
venue: Paris Montreuil Expo, 128 rue de Paris
description: A major celebration of children's and young adult publishing, with illustrators, comics, readings, workshops and exhibitions exploring the boundaries between fiction and reality.
accessNote: Free entry, but every adult and child needs an online ticket; booking opens 5 October. Monday is the professional day and remains open to all visitors; some professional sessions require accreditation.

title: Più libri più liberi · Independent Book Fair
description: Rome's fair devoted to small and medium-sized independent publishers brings book discoveries, author encounters, readings, debates and performances to La Nuvola.
accessNote: Open 10:00–20:00. Fair admission requires a ticket; event rooms fill on a first-come basis. Reserved sessions are for schools.
